content.text: {"regions":{"r2":{"type":"stanza_note","lines":[{"n":1,"text":"means allurement or distraction; one commentary explains it","end":"space"},{"n":2,"text":"also as आदर. पर्यस्त. lit. tossed about; hence distracted. अल्पवद्","end":"space"},{"n":3,"text":"भवति—the man engaged in the pursuit of worldly objects finds","end":"space"},{"n":4,"text":"time too short to achieve all his ends. वासराणां the gen. by ‘अधीग-","end":"hyphen"},{"n":5,"text":"र्थदयेशां कर्मणि’ Pán II. 3. 52. ध्यानच्छेदे—ध्यान is defined by","end":"space"},{"n":6,"text":"Patanjali as ‘तत्र प्रत्ययैकतानता ( sameness of perception; see","end":"space"},{"n":7,"text":"com. sl. 99 ). ध्यानम्—(1) at the end of my contemplation; (2)","end":"space"},{"n":8,"text":"during the interval between two समाधि s. The idea is this—","end":"space"},{"n":9,"text":"after I shall have broken my समाधि, I shall smile at the life of","end":"space"},{"n":10,"text":"misery led by worldly people. May the time come when I shall","end":"space"},{"n":11,"text":"be free from desire and renouncing the world enjoy the happi-","end":"hyphen"},{"n":12,"text":"ness of समाधि.","end":"space"}],"uncertain":true,"note":"Some Sanskrit readings, particularly the phrase at the end of line 2 and the divided grammatical quotation, are unclear."},"r3":{"type":"stanza_note","lines":[{"n":1,"text":"Sl. 30. संतोष०—संतोषेण निरन्तरं always or greatly, highly","end":"space"},{"n":2,"text":"प्रमुदिताः delighted. Mr. Telang reads संतोषसुखप्रमोदभरिताः","end":"space"},{"n":3,"text":"but we do not see the propriety of प्रमोद and मुदित which mean","end":"space"},{"n":4,"text":"the same thing. भिन्नाः—interrupted, unaltered; they enjoy","end":"space"},{"n":5,"text":"unmixed felicity ( not affected by the report about the treasures","end":"space"},{"n":6,"text":"of Meru ). The joys of ordinary men are often interrupted by","end":"space"},{"n":7,"text":"misfortunes, the thwarting of their desires &c. हता—mark the","end":"space"},{"n":8,"text":"contrast. The happiness of the one never comes to an end; the","end":"space"},{"n":9,"text":"thirst of the other never ends and makes him perpetuall misera-","end":"hyphen"},{"n":10,"text":"ble. हर्षं &c —The sentence ends with मेरुः; supply सः or एत-","end":"hyphen"},{"n":11,"text":"द्विधेः हर्षं as nom. to रोचते. This indicates Vairágya, and so the","end":"space"},{"n":12,"text":"sl. is in its proper place here. The idea seems to be this–A sane","end":"space"},{"n":13,"text":"person never does any thing without some motive. But it is","end":"space"},{"n":14,"text":"difficult to see what the motive of Brahmà was in creating","end":"space"},{"n":15,"text":"Meru. Those who are self-contented have nothing to do with","end":"space"},{"n":16,"text":"it. If the object be to gratify the lust for money of avaricious","end":"space"},{"n":17,"text":"persons, Meru, with its unending treasures, can never fulfil it.","end":"space"},{"n":18,"text":"“ S’árngadhara p. 20 ascribes this to Vidyápati. ” Mr. Telang.","end":"space"}],"uncertain":true,"note":"Several Sanskrit words, especially the variant in line 2 and the quotation in lines 10–11, are difficult to read."},"r4":{"type":"stanza_note","lines":[{"n":1,"text":"Sl. 31. अदैन्यं–in which there is no self-abasement; in which","end":"space"},{"n":2,"text":"one has not the misery of undergoing humiliation, or making","end":"space"},{"n":3,"text":"abject supplication. अप्रतिहतं–This reading is better than अप्रति-","end":"hyphen"},{"n":4,"text":"हृतं as it nearly means the same thing as अकार्यं. अप्रतिहत may","end":"space"},{"n":5,"text":"mean knowing no obstruction, producing every desired effect.","end":"space"}],"uncertain":true,"note":"The Sanskrit variant readings in lines 3–4 are not entirely clear."},"r1":{"type":"page_number","lines":[{"n":1,"text":"( 59 )","end":"space"}],"uncertain":false,"note":null}},"units":[{"id":"u1","type":"notes","number":null,"label":null,"open_start":true,"open_end":true,"children":["u2","u3","u4"]},{"id":"u2","type":"stanza_note","number":"29","label":null,"open_start":true,"open_end":false,"children":["r2"]},{"id":"u3","type":"stanza_note","number":"30","label":null,"open_start":false,"open_end":false,"children":["r3"]},{"id":"u4","type":"stanza_note","number":"31","label":null,"open_start":false,"open_end":true,"children":["r4"]}],"flows":[{"flow":"main","units":["u1"]}],"relations":[]}
